## Review decisions

Record each substantive AI/human finding, reproduction/evidence, accepted/rejected/deferred decision, reason and validation. Do not paste secrets or private evidence.

## Boundaries

- [ ] Deterministic authorization, budget, disclosure, stop and unknown are preserved.
- [ ] Acceptance, ActionApproval, adoption, deployment, reuse and revocation remain distinct.
- [ ] Initial E, standard Executor and original D14 acceptance scope are preserved.
- [ ] Workflow, dependencies, rights and public file changes were explicitly reviewed.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, real ledger, live provider operation or paid add-on was used for CI.
